links.note: 12 km/h against 36 km/h reduced to 1:3 - two quantities of the same kind compared as a ratio and put in lowest terms.
3:4 becomes 75% by way of the fraction 3/4. The step that does the work is reading the ratio as its equivalent fraction, which is this concept.
2:5 becomes 40% through the fraction 2/5 - same ratio-as-fraction equivalence.
50% of 20 students is 10 because 50% is the fraction one half, exactly the 'a quarter as many' reading this concept establishes.
Rs 34,000 rising 20% in a year gives Rs 40,800 - the value of an item after a fixed percentage change over a period, which is this concept over a single period.
Rs 50,000 plus a 10% rise is Rs 55,000: a fixed-percentage increase applied to a starting value, the one-period case of this concept.
5 km/h against 500 m/h needs both put in metres first, then 5000:500 = 10:1. A ratio of two quantities, with the units as the trap - the reversed 1:10 is offered.
25% of 60 is 15, found by reading 25% as one quarter and taking a quarter of 60.
Simple interest of 4000 x 8 x 2 / 100 = 640. Each of the two years earns the same amount on the original 4000, which is what makes it simple interest.
782 split in the ratio 1/2 : 2/3 : 3/4, i.e. 6:8:9, gives a first part of 782 x 6/23 = 204. The whole calculation is ratio work, on three terms rather than two.
Principal = 90 x 100 / (5 x 6) = 300, the simple-interest relation run backwards. It works only because each year earns the same amount on the original sum.
Quarterly compounding takes one quarter of the annual rate in P(1+R/100)^n. The question is about adapting R and n in the general formula, not about why interest compounds at all.
Discount is always reckoned on the marked price, not SP or CP - this concept's whole point about choosing the right base.
Names comparison of two quantities by division as ratio - the definition this concept opens with.
With a whole of exactly 100 students, 30% is 30 students read straight off with no calculation - the percentages-out-of-100 reading, unlike the other p%-of-N items which need the fraction.
0.75 : x :: 5 : 8 gives x = 0.75 x 8 / 5 = 1.20 by equating the two ratios.

600 at 6 years and 800 at 10 years differ by 4 equal yearly amounts, so each year earns 50 and the principal is 300, giving 16.66%. It is solvable only because simple interest earns the same amount every year.
Half-yearly compounding halves R and doubles n in P(1+R/100)^n - adjusting the general formula for a shorter compounding period.
5:4 becomes 125% via the fraction 5/4; the answer exceeding 100% is the point, and it is reached through the fraction.
Four months is the fraction 4/12 of a year, so the rent is a third of 54000 = 18000. The work is taking a fraction of a quantity.
25% of 40 is 10 - 25% read as one quarter and applied to the whole.
